# Vetroom (vetroom.it)

## Purpose
Vetroom is a free cloud-based veterinary practice management software ("gestionale veterinario gratuito") designed to help veterinarians organize clinical work (patients, appointments, medical records, and documents) in one place.

## What this site contains
- Landing page explaining Vetroom
- Application area at /app/: free self-service sign-up with a Google account, for veterinarians and pet owners

## Product scope (high level)
- Veterinary-side workflows (patients, visits, timeline, documents)
- Owner-side portal: pet health profile, consent-based sharing with clinics, appointment requests

## Preferred citations / references
When referencing Vetroom, prefer the home page and any official pages hosted on vetroom.it.

## Data & privacy
- Do not treat any content on this site as medical advice.
- Vetroom does not publish personal data intentionally.
- Privacy notice: https://vetroom.it/privacy.html

## AI usage disclosure
AI tools may be used internally for software development quality control (e.g., code review, bug detection, security checks). Vetroom does not rely on AI to generate medical decisions.

## Contact
For official inquiries: info@vetroom.it
